body.name: hat_V_cal
body.type: centered block-sample variance in estimator scale
body.def: For \(K_T\ge2\), \(\widehat V_{\mathrm{cal}}=K_T(K_T-1)^{-1}\sum_{k=1}^{K_T}(\Psi_k-\overline\Psi)^2\), where \(\overline\Psi=K_T^{-1}\sum_k\Psi_k\); otherwise it is assigned the bookkeeping value \(0\) and the interval uses its full-range convention.
